newsitem.title: USA: Shell says U.S. Capline nominations down for Nov.
newsitem.headline: Shell says U.S. Capline nominations down for Nov.

text.p: Shell Oil said Monday that November crude oil nominations on Capline, a large pipeline into the U.S. Midwest, fell again compared with the previous month.
Nominations for November were 965,612 barrels per day (bpd), about 3,190 bpd less than actual October volumes.
October nominations earlier last month were 1,001,209 bpd, highlighting anticipated high demand.
Traders said autumn refinery turnarounds and high throughout on Canada's IPL pipeline diminished some demand on Capline, a major artery from the Gulf Coast into the Midwest.
Capline has a total capacity of about 1.1 to 1.2 million bpd, and Shell Oil, a unit of the Royal Dutch/Shell Group is the operator of the line.
